items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: You don’t need to have one Ornette Coleman record, you should have them all you know.

ctx.x: A quote from you: “Certain people have forced me to wake up and face my evolution.” It sounds like you needed to be prodded to move ahead into something new? I don’t want to read too much into that, but I thought it was a very interesting statement.

Well there are certain people who introduced me to things that I may not have been checking out musically. And certain people came along and said look, if you really want to evolve as a complete piano player you might want to check this out. You know? You don’t need to have one Ornette Coleman record, you should have them all you know. And so I had to really deal with that you know, and make sure I was evolving. Because it’s so funny, it’s so easy to be in the barber shop, you know? And just say this is how I am.…
